essence: Middle-opening means powerful thought-decay, many ways.
Nothing-thinking decays thoughts; play-power enamoured in being.
Attached sees bright flood; tightening brahma-called.
Goddess speaks; strong win reward in days.
Impressed roamer reflects again and again.
Sporting yogi mantra-stayed, strong playing power-swollen.

sections.SUMMARY: Opening holds means: powerful thought-decay-opening state, manifold. Nothing thought, thoughts decay; play-power enamoured in being's field. Attached sees; tightening brahma-teachers call it — fie. Rest-points and passion-grasps listed whole. Goddess-voiced opening; strong obtain supreme reward in days. Samādhi-impressed roams pure-rayed, reflecting by emission-power doubled. Even distracted, own form shines for awareness-fixed bliss-essenced yogi. Bliss-manifest mantra-strong full-I-knowing: inward devotee's. Sporting stayed mantra-situated; strong playing power-expanded. Freedom his, everywhere, world-Lord's, difference-tasting, wonder-state-unbroken.

rasa.dominant: vīra of means; śānta-vīra of decayed thoughts; vīra of recorded calling; adbhuta of listed rests; vīra of goddess-voiced reward; vīra of doubled reflecting; vīra of distraction-proof shining; vīra of mantra-strength; līlā-vīra of situated sport; vīra of unbroken freedom
rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at powerful stand; śamotsāha at nothing-thought decay; utsāha at brahma-teachers quoted; vismaya at whole-listed rests; utsāha at days-win reward; utsāha at again-and-again; utsāha at shining-undimmed; utsāha at strengthened knowing; līlotsāha at stayed-yet-sporting; utsāha at difference-tasted-unbroken
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: opened middle, powerful stand. Means relished. The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: nothing thought, thoughts decayed. Decay relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: seen bright, called tight. Quoting relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: rests listed whole. Listing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: spoken goddess, won reward. Voicing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: roaming, reflecting, doubled. Roaming relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: distracted even, shining full. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: manifest, strengthened, devotee's. Strength relished. The sthāyibhāva is playful exultation: stayed, strong, sporting. Situating relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: free, tasting, unbroken. Unbrokenness relished.
